_comment: Asian board for the 2026-08-31 slate (Taipei 09-01), eleven games, read about ten hours before first pitch. Third slate of the prospective test. Brewers at Cubs is on the US card but not this board. All eleven favourites agree with the US moneyline -- including Marlins at Nationals, which was yesterday's decisive flag: the board again puts the handicap on Miami's row, and today the market agrees at 0.524. Yesterday it had Washington at 0.5093, so the game was a coin flip the market called marginally the other way while the board's view stayed put; Miami then won 6-2. That is one game and settles nothing, but it argues against treating my row reading as the thing that is wrong whenever it disagrees with a near-even market. The three conflicts ever resolved by a visible moneyline column all involved clear favourites at 0.578, 0.621 and 0.633, where a misread row is the likely explanation. Near a coin flip the board and the market can simply differ, which is why those stay flagged and priced both ways rather than corrected.
